relationship: Crystal worked on the same team as Marcos
text:
Marcos is a rare kind of engineer. He's excellent at his craft, and he pairs that with something I value just as much. He is a true thought partner. We've worked together on many projects, but a few stand out. On our LLM document classification and extraction work, he was my partner well beyond the engineering. He held our vendors accountable to what they promised, and when it became clear we could do things more accurately in-house, he found and built the alternatives that got us there. On our communication service, he's been my go-to. He built a foundation the operations team could actually trust, so when we started layering LLMs and agentic workflows on top, we were building from solid ground.

As a PM, I work with him closely, and what stands out is how deeply curious he is about our users. He isn't satisfied just knowing what happened or what the team asked for. He really digs into the why and the actual need underneath the request, and he makes sure the problem is truly solved before he calls it done. He also up-levels everyone around him. He pushes for the team to get better and for the work to get better, and he's the person the room looks to.

Part of that is his energy. He's kind and thoughtful, but he also says the thing that needs to be said and holds us to real alignment and understanding, not just consensus. Working with Marcos makes the product better and makes the rest of us sharper. Any team would be fortunate to have him.
